day_shape: 63 items: Iranian missile attack on Aqaba with Eilat explosions, Trump threat to strike Iranian bridge/power plant per Hormuz ship attack, NYT-cited four Iranian strikes on King Faisal base, heavy Khamenei/IRGC Hormuz messaging, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Trump retaliation threat
threads.summary: Trump threatened to strike an Iranian bridge or power plant for each Iranian attack on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, per Jerusalem Post, while Rubio said Washington would keep targeting Iran's shipping-attack capability but remained open to diplomacy. Khamenei's office and IRIB posted messages asserting Iranian control over the Strait and vowing to secure the Persian Gulf.

threads.label: Iranian strikes on Jordan and Gulf alarms
threads.summary: Iranian missiles were launched toward Aqaba with explosions heard in Eilat and US interceptions reported, and IRIB cited a New York Times account of four Iranian attacks on King Faisal Air Base in Jordan over five days. Defa Press posted a purported satellite image of the strikes and reported explosions in Saudi Arabia with Bahrain warning-system activation.

threads.label: IRGC spokesman claims on war performance
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried a series of statements from armed forces spokesman Commander Shakarchchi claiming strategic missile production continued throughout 40 days of war, that enemies cannot locate Iran's missile facilities, and that a UAE data centre was destroyed. Additional remarks framed US expulsion from West Asia as strategy and claimed Iranian innovation reshaped warfare.

threads.label: US diplomacy posture and MAGA sentiment
threads.summary: Rubio said the US remains open to diplomacy but Iran rejected a mediator-proposed 10-day ceasefire, and Trump is to attend the return of four US soldiers' bodies at Dover. IRIB cited a Politico poll showing MAGA support for the Iran war fell from about 50% in May to just over a third, a 13-point drop.

threads.label: Iran domestic war impact and vengeance messaging
threads.summary: IRIB reported a producers' support package within 15 days for war-damaged units and electricity stabilisation in five southern provinces after a 1,520 MW load reduction, alongside Kharg Island denials of any explosion. Defa Press and Khamenei's office pushed vengeance messaging around the Minab school martyrs and a conference on "realising the promise of vengeance."

threads.label: Lebanon, Hamas and Gaza tracks
threads.summary: Lebanon and Israel are scheduled for US-brokered talks on 4 August in Italy per a Lebanese official, while Berri dismissed the Aoun-Trump meeting as producing no practical results. Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya delivered a first speech vowing no compromise on Palestine, and the IDF released details on 12 Gaza operatives it says had been presented as soccer players.

threads.label: Diplomatic frictions around Iran
threads.summary: An Iranian foreign ministry official denied that two French diplomats were mistreated during their detention in Tehran, and Bulgaria played down Iran's warning against hosting US tanker aircraft. Iran International held a town hall where analysts said bombing Iran's coast risks an IRGC takeover without a plan for succession in Tehran.

events.title_en: Condolence message from the Leader of the Revolution on the occasion of the death of the mother of the Mozafar martyrs. His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message expressed his condolences on the death of the esteemed and devout mother of the Mozafar martyrs. Text of the message from the Leader of the Islamic Revolution: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful. Honourable Mr. Hossein Mozafar, Peace be upon you; I express my condolences on the passing of your esteemed mother, the sacrificing and patient mother of the honoured martyrs Hasan, Ali and Reza Mozafar (may God's mercy be upon them), to you and the other respected survivors and the families of the martyrs and those who have sacrificed. This esteemed and devout lady, by raising children faithful and committed to defending the sanctity of the Islamic Revolution, has attained the exalted station of divine proximity.
